# Vendored files

`usb_export.py` is an unmodified copy of `phone_export/usb_export.py` from the planning package
(`field_route_logger_planning_20261003_v1`). The demo decodes and checks records only with this file.

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `usb_export.py` | `a55af8ebacbae2d72d1d49fd5a18e6c2618fd42e70fe412752f363dcf681dde8` |

`tests/test_static.py` (test_vendored_usb_export_is_unmodified) fails if the copy changes. Any change is made in the planning package first and copied here
again, with the new SHA-256 written above.
